ignoreValues.reason: Glyph and input sizes, not type-ramp text: the ⋯/× menu triggers render a character as an icon with line-height:1, and .zui-palette-input is a text field at 16px, which is what stops iOS zooming the page on focus. Verified case by case in the design audit.
A 4px-tall momentum bar: 2px is half its height, and the documented 8px would round it away entirely. A shape at this scale is not on the radius scale.
The calendar's event chip is a few pixels tall; 8px would swallow it. Same reasoning as the 2px momentum bar.
mask alpha, not a painted colour
